label: wrc-frame step 1 frame build (thresholds in this probe)

preconditions.name: frame stage built on every seed

thresholds: (a) >= 1 co-firing event on >= 13/15 seeds; (b) mean own-role gain >= 1.5 on >= 13/15 seeds; either absent -> AMPA-with-discharge fallback reported, no bar picked here.
undefined_reasons: unmet: thresholds: gain present on >= 13 seeds (measured=False expect=True)
